hints.title: Two Halves of Array
hints.text: The array contains 2n elements: x1..xn from 0 to n - 1, and y1..yn from n to 2n - 1.

hints.title: Interleave Elements
hints.text: For each index i from 0 to n - 1, append nums[i] followed by nums[i + n].

hints.title: Return Result Array
hints.text: The interleaved result has length 2n matching [x1, y1, x2, y2, ..., xn, yn].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive pitfalls; direct interleaving is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear scan allocates output array of size 2n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate cleanly interleaves elements with a single loop.
